scripts.build: pnpm --filter @blitz/shared build && pnpm --filter @blitz/server build && pnpm --filter @blitz/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @blitz/shared test && pnpm --filter @blitz/server test && pnpm --filter @blitz/web test && node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @blitz/shared build && pnpm --filter @blitz/shared lint && pnpm --filter @blitz/server lint && pnpm --filter @blitz/web lint
scripts.verify:bootstrap: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && node tests/bootstrap-smoke.mjs
